description: This file defines the implementation of a UserService in Java, specifically the UserServiceImpl class which provides methods to find, create, update, and delete User entities using a data access object (UserDao). It leverages Spring framework annotations for dependency injection and service declaration.

classes.name: UserServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of UserService interface, providing methods for user management such as find, create, update, and delete.

methods.name: findUser
methods.description: Retrieves a User by its ID, converting string input to integer for DAO query.

methods.name: createUser
methods.description: Creates a new User record in the database.

methods.name: updateUser
methods.description: Updates an existing User record in the database.

methods.name: deleteUser
methods.description: Deletes a User by its ID.
